map.🔢 胸水 Light 标准渗出/漏出鉴别器: 🔢 Pleural Fluid Light Criteria Exudate/Transudate Differentiator
map.依据 Light 标准(胸水/血清蛋白比值、LDH比值、胸水LDH)判别胸腔积液: Uses Light's criteria (pleural/serum protein ratio, LDH ratio, pleural LDH) to classify pleural effusion
map.📖 查看「胸水 Light 标准渗出/漏出鉴别器 使用指南」: 📖 View the Pleural Fluid Light Criteria Differentiator user guide
Light's criteria for exudate (any one suffices): pleural/serum protein ratio >0.5; pleural/serum LDH ratio >0.6; pleural LDH > 2/3 of the upper limit of normal serum LDH; if none is met, it is a transudate.
map.血清 LDH 正常上限 (U/L): Serum LDH upper limit of normal (U/L)
map.> 2/3 血清LDH正常上限: > 2/3 of serum LDH upper limit of normal
map.肺炎旁积液、结核、恶性肿瘤、肺栓塞、自身免疫病: Parapneumonic effusion, tuberculosis, malignancy, pulmonary embolism, autoimmune disease
map.心衰、肝硬化、肾病综合征、低蛋白血症: Heart failure, cirrhosis, nephrotic syndrome, hypoalbuminemia
map.提示：Light标准敏感性高、特异性略低，心衰利尿后可能将漏出液误判为渗出液，此: Note: Light's criteria are sensitive but less specific; after diuresis for heart failure a transudate may be misread as exudate - a serum-pleural albumin gradient >12 g/L supports transudate. Pleural NT-proBNP >1500 pg/mL also supports a cardiac transudate. Clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：胸水 Light 标准: 📚 Deep Dive: Pleural Fluid Light's Criteria
map.胸水蛋白 3.5/血清 6.0=0.583>0.5→满足一条，判渗出液。: Pleural protein 3.5 / serum 6.0 = 0.583 > 0.5 -> one criterion met, classified as exudate.
map.胸水 LDH 250/血清 LDH 200=1.25>0.6，或胸水 LDH>血: Pleural LDH 250 / serum LDH 200 = 1.25 > 0.6, or pleural LDH > 2/3 of serum upper limit -> exudate.
map.三条满足几条？: How many of the three must be met?
map.满足任一条即渗出；漏出液三条均不满足。: Any one means exudate; a transudate meets none.
map.心衰/低蛋白时可出现\"假性渗出\"，需结合临床与 NT-proBNP。: Heart failure or low albumin can produce a 'pseudo-exudate'; combine with clinical context and NT-proBNP.
